$comment: GH-680 (item 3bi) — page divergences: node x view pairs the fixpoint finds that the graph
does not declare as intent. The batch closes three ways (analyst 77.23): the intent is
recognised and the view joins ; the code stops loading the file or loses the entry;
or, for a listener, what reachable means is narrowed and the pair leaves on its own.
Nothing is ADDED to the batch: a new divergence reddens by name with its own ticket.
Both directions: a pair that became declared, or left the found set, reddens as
GH-723 (item 3bi): every entry now carries its OWN reason and the facts it rests on.
One ticket over eighty-five entries answered for the batch and not for the entry;
a month later nobody could say why a given pair was here. `why` is a fact of the code:
which file the root is and which file the handle is declared in, on that very view.

reMeasuredBecauseTheRuleChanged.what: members are resolved ON THE VIEW rather than over the catalogue; callers are keyed by the RESOLVED TARGET rather than by the name; on* attributes of the views count as page entry points; and a top level in a file no view loads is not a root
reMeasuredBecauseTheRuleChanged.note: this movement is growth BY RULE, not by code, and it is printed apart for that reason

narrowedByGh723.what: reachable on a view now requires the view to load the HANDLE's file as well as the root's. A view that loads only the root cannot run the node: the function is not on the page.
narrowedByGh723.note: the dropped edges are a defect OF THE WALK, not of the product, and they are printed by the run under [gh723]. They need a ticket of their own; naming them is what keeps this narrowing from being a filter over the symptom.

ambient-dli-engine : hub : top-level.why: ambient-dli-engine is reachable on hub: the view loads its root assets/sensor-integration-manager.js AND the file its handle is declared in, assets/ambient-dli-engine.js. `hub` is the run frame, which no client opens; internal accounting.

ambient-dli-engine : reports/export : to.why: ambient-dli-engine is reachable on reports/export: the view loads its root assets/sensor-integration-manager.js AND the file its handle is declared in, assets/ambient-dli-engine.js. A report page loading an engine file itself is the GH-459 family: the numbers a reader sees could be computed ON THE PAGE instead of read from the stored result. CANDIDATE, NOT ESTABLISHED — proving it needs a wrapper in place on a live page (98.1), and no live run was taken.
